summary: Every required and elective course must be taken for a letter grade with a C or better, toward the 65 units the major needs (71 with honors). The audit checks ARTSTUDI 101, 102 and ARTHIST 5, 16 units of 100-level ARTSTUDI courses, 16 units of 200-level ARTSTUDI courses other than the major seminar and capstone (up to 4 honors units may count there), three art history electives (any ARTHIST course, at most one FILMEDIA course), ARTSTUDI 201 and ARTSTUDI 249. You check by hand the library orientation, an outside art history course your advisor approves, at most two courses (10 units) taken away from Stanford, and for honors the A- in each honors course, the fall review, the exhibition and the written thesis.
